special.initialPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a production 2D side-scrolling game animation sprite sheet of Raiden Shogun. This is a RECONSTRUCTION OF THE OLD ANIMATION, not a redesign. References: image1 is the old actions sheet; strictly use its LAST ROW of four poses as the animation skeleton. Image2 is old skill art, identity/style support only. Image3 is character portrait, costume/face/weapon detail reference only.
Deliver ONE native transparent RGBA sheet, 4 columns by 3 rows, exactly 12 separate full-body frames read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Landscape 4:3 canvas, preferably 1536x1152. No grid, no text, no numbers, no floor, no background, no additional separate effect figures. Every cell has generous transparent margins of at least 16 pixels around every hair tip, sleeve and sword tip. Never let neighboring frames overlap.
Same adult woman in each frame, same consistent proportions and grounded elegant anime painterly style as OLD SHEET, same white/lavender long kimono sleeves with gold patterns, deep purple thigh-high stockings and shoes, dark violet very long thick braid, red obi bow, purple floral hair ornament. Same long curved purple katana with round elaborate guard throughout, not a straight short baton. Right-facing three-quarter SIDE VIEW exactly like old first reference, never turn into front-facing portrait. Consistent body size, about 245 source pixels crown-to-sole when standing in a 384x384 cell.
Action L: IN-PLACE CHARGED HORIZONTAL LIGHTNING WAVE SLASH. Feet grounded around a stable pivot; no running, no leap or forward dash. Restore old last-row readable shapes: vertical blade gathered in front of face/chest, then powerful waist-turn horizontal slash forward, followthrough leaning slightly forward, low guard recovery. Do NOT make all frames a straight stiff extended arm pushing sword. Shoulder, elbow and wrist anatomy naturally follows curved blade sweep, no broken wrist. Do not summon an energy sphere. Do not make an upward attack or overhead downward chop.
FRAME 1: low ready, elbow bent, starts lifting curved blade inward in front of torso.
FRAME 2: erect narrow stance, curved blade vertical in front of face, elbow relaxed bent.
FRAME 3: gathered poised stance, blade vertical above face, faint purple charge along blade only.
FRAME 4: final tense windup, hips turning, vertical blade slightly drawn beside head, arm bent.
FRAME 5: initiating big horizontal cut from body rotation, blade diagonal forward transitioning through shoulder height, wide planted stance.
FRAME 6: decisive forward horizontal slash at chest height, natural bent shoulder/elbow extension, blade fully across front, slight purple thin edge trail; matches old last-row second frame silhouette.
FRAME 7: torso leans slightly forward, blade reaches ahead at near-horizontal, rear sleeve/braid lag behind; matches old last-row third frame silhouette.
FRAME 8: arm and blade continue slightly downward-forward along cut arc, front knee flexed.
FRAME 9: blade smoothly lowers to forward hip height, hips start relaxing.
FRAME 10: torso returns upright, sword diagonally low forward, braid settling.
FRAME 11: low blade guard returning planted feet toward normal width.
FRAME 12: calm old last-row fourth frame ending stance, long curved blade low forward, same identity/scale. Add minimal blade violet gleam only: the game draws lightning projectile separately.
Priority: authentic old attack silhouette and elegant natural body mechanics; unique meaningful sequential poses; stable torso/legs size and planted feet; entire long curved blade within each cell; true alpha background.

Correct by uniformly reducing all 12 entire character-plus-weapons drawings to about 80% of their current size and recentering them into their individual cells. All 12 sprites retain ONE consistent physical body scale; no independent stretched figure or shorter weapon to fit. This image has the correct narrow curved katana, correct twelve old Raiden action poses, correct costume, proportions and restrained blade light. Preserve every one of these invariants; do NOT change or thicken sword. secondary.initialPrompt:

Primary request: reconstruct and expand the OLD Raiden Shogun thunder-calling skill from reference image1, using those exact FOUR key poses as animation skeleton. Image2 old action sheet reinforces matching identity/proportions/style. Image3 portrait is costume/long curved sword detail reference. Do not invent a new summon stance.
Deliver ONE sheet 4 columns by3rows, exactly12 separate full-body frames left to right top to bottom, landscape4:3 preferably1536x1152. Each frame complete and contains the whole long sword and braid with at least24px transparent safety gutter around it. In each cell, SAME adult body scale approximately200pixels head-to-sole at a384x384cell. Raised long sword can extend well above head and MUST fit fully with blank space. Feet align along stable ground line in all rows.
Same Raiden old painterly anime sprite style: white/lavender kimono flowing sleeves, subtle gold ornamental pattern, red obi bow, deep purple thigh high stockings and shoes, dark violet thick long braid, gold purple floral hair ornament. Same adult proportions as old sheet, graceful strong grounded shape. Right-facing three-quarter SIDE VIEW as original old four poses, not frontal presentation. Sword consistently LONG SLENDER GENTLY CURVED purple JAPANESE KATANA around70% body-height blade, round ornate hilt, no short chunky dagger or straight stick. Hands, elbows and shoulders natural, blade rigid from hilt to tip in every frame.
I action = COMMAND A THUNDER COLUMN in front, standing in place. Original key poses: diagonal-raised sword ready → one hand raises blade VERTICALLY overhead, free arm naturally extended to side → guide lightning by lowering sword FORWARD around chest and waist, NOT strike the earth → low guard finish.
Frames:
1 old reference first pose: ready with bent elbow and long curved sword diagonally forward/up.
2 raise forearm and sword to steeper diagonal, natural planted weight shift.
3 sword near vertical beside front of head, elbow almost extending upward, free arm spreading.
4 old second pose beginning: sword-arm fully raised, wrist aligned, blade vertical skyward, wide sleeves hang elegantly.
5 old second pose at thunder-call peak: arm straight up, whole long curved blade pointing UP well above crown, free arm relaxed sideways, only thin edge purple gleam.
6 hold high call for short beat, small torso/sleeve followthrough, NO energy cloud obscuring body.
7 rotate shoulder to guide sword FORWARD and down from high position, blade diagonal-up in front of face, free arm naturally balances.
8 old third pose: forward reach with gently bent elbow, blade nearly horizontal chest-height and curved tip a little lower, directing column in front.
9 continue forward-down guide to waist height, calm controlled torso rotation, do NOT slam sword to ground or crouch.
10 old fourth pose beginning: draw hand slightly back, sword low diagonally forward.
11 low guard settling shoulders, braid settles behind.
12 exact old fourth resting silhouette, low curved sword held diagonally forward and grounded relaxed legs.
No external lightning pillar or large effect in the atlas; runtime renders it. Minimal faint violet blade edge only, NO glowing ball/cloud on chest or feet. Same body mass and scale in allframes, no crop, extra limbs, duplicated blade, foot sliding, leap or dash. Priority: unmistakable classic old pose sequence with naturally articulated transitions.

secondary.poseNotes: Diagonal sword ready → one-hand vertical skyward call → forward guide down to waist → low guard. No ground chop; runtime thunder column separate.

registration.method: Read-only Pillow alpha inspection plus visual registration; PNG files copied verbatim from native generation output. No code image modification.
registration.bodyScale: One fixed measured standingBodyHeightPixels per clip, reflecting source atlas scale; runtime targets same body height. No per-frame stretch.
registration.sourceRect: Alpha >20 content bounding box plus 12px padding, measured separately per frame.
registration.footAnchor: Normalized crop-local midpoint between the planted shoe contact extents; y from the lowest alpha>128 sole pixel plus one.
registration.weaponTip: Visually registered actual katana tip in crop-local source pixels.
registration.phaseWeights: Equal weights within every phase so fast attack timing preserves reachability.
